coaching.headline: A proper fucking finish.
coaching.team: We repeatedly followed won fight sequences with objectives or structures, then finished through their base. The ugly Mini Prime exchange still belongs in the review; winning the game does not turn every trade into genius.

focus.title: Cash the win
focus.action: After the next won fight, name the nearest safe objective or structure and take it. Another kill is optional; progress toward the Core is the point.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow did the fucking job: team-leading damage and kills, without a mountain of deaths. Keep that balance and keep hitting the targets that can be reached safely. Make this level of output and survival repeatable.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Keep this version of Murdock: strong farm, very few deaths, reliable income. Carry that restraint into close games too. There is no need to turn a productive performance into a gamble for another kill.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: The Core does not give a shit how pretty the damage chart looks. Iggy & Scorch brought strong farm, objective damage and survival, which made this a productive game. Keep taking reachable farm and helping finish objectives instead of chasing a prettier hero-damage total.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Lt. Belica put wards down and contributed to kills. That is support work worth keeping. The early death to Revenant still deserves attention, even in a win: before the next contest, make the retreat condition explicit and follow it.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Khaimera kept the farm moving and led objective damage. Keep that pressure, but four wards is barely using the vision slot. Winning does not make that good enough. Run sentry next game and actively clear enemy vision before ganks and objective takes; do not just carry the damn thing.

9.3.call: The kill sequence ended 1-3. Mini Prime was secured afterward; the objective take does not establish that the deaths were avoidable or worthwhile.

15.6.call: The kill sequence ended 3-0. Mini Prime was secured during it, an Outer Tower followed, and Fangtooth came later.

24.7.call: The final kill sequence ended 5-2 while enemy structures fell. Their Core fell shortly afterward.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Steel, Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
ourKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
ourKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
enemyKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

loadout.name: Endless Hunt
loadout.text: Takedowns reset Sparrow's Basic Ability Cooldowns and permanently grant 1 Physical Penetration.
loadout.plain: Each takedown resets Piercing Shot, Hail of Arrows and Heightened Senses and adds permanent armor penetration. After the first kill she can stealth again and keep fighting.

loadout.name: Weald
loadout.text: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage. Missiles travel through walls and disappear after 3000u. 10s cooldown per Hero. On-hit effects apply at 20% effectiveness.
loadout.plain: Hitting a hero below 30% health fires missiles that pass through walls, with more missiles from bonus attack speed, which she builds a lot of. Helps finish low enemies running away.

loadout.name: Forage
loadout.text: Gain 3 additional Gold and 3 additional XP per Minion or Monster kill.
loadout.plain: Extra gold and experience from every minion and monster kill. Generic farming boost, nothing special with her kit.

loadout.name: Wind-Rider
loadout.text: Gain 15% (+1% per Level) Bonus Attack Speed for 4s after using a Dash, Leap, Teleport, or upon leaving Stealth.
loadout.plain: Leaving stealth after Heightened Senses gives extra attack speed on top of what the ability already grants, so that damage window hits even faster.

loadout.name: Pacifier
loadout.text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.
loadout.plain: Dash and empower her next hit, which hits much harder on low-health targets and can be recast after a kill. Use it to finish someone softened by Piercing Shot.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,323 hero damage a minute, more than 86% of Sparrow carry players this patch (38% of the team's). The damage came from Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds, Pacifier.
17 takedowns (12 kills, 5 assists) fed: Endless Hunt (augment).
Sparrow dealt 34,407 hero damage, 38% of their team's, with +152 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Revenant (level 13: about 85 physical armor, 73 after penetration; took 14,652 physical damage from heroes, 67% of all hero damage they took) and Steel (level 13: about 139 physical armor, 127 after penetration; took 17,867 physical damage from heroes, 59% of all hero damage they took) that is about 7% and 5% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Weald (Eternal): Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage.

Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Vanquisher, Weald. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
The Eternal was part of it: Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; finishing damage on low-health targets), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Sparrow killed built physical armor (Steel). We killed Sparrow 2 times.

Copy it? Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider): 52.1% in 3,913 Sparrow carry games, above the hero's 50.2%; this 3-item core: 56.8% in 628 games, level with the 56% of that hero-role's cores. Proven this patch: worth copying.
